verified: Electrek reports that BMW says the iX5 is its first fully electric US-built vehicle, with an estimated range of up to 456 miles, ultra-fast charging and Neue Klasse technology.
unconfirmed: price, production timing, battery size, charging power and the EPA-certified range all rest on BMW's announcement and were not provided. The source also contradicts itself on range — the article text and headline say 456 miles, while the page's own URL slug says 435 miles — so neither figure should be treated as final.

verified: 据Electrek报道，宝马iX5是其首款在美国生产的纯电动车，宝马宣称其预估续航最高456英里、支持超快充电，并搭载Neue Klasse技术。
unconfirmed: 456英里是厂商预估值，而非EPA认证结果；充电“超快”的具体功率、电池容量、售价、投产与交付时间均未公布；此外报道网址写作435英里，与正文的456英里存在数字冲突，哪一数字准确尚无独立来源确认。

titles.en: BMW iX5: first US-built EV, 456-mile range claim
titles.zh: 宝马美国首款本土生产电动车iX5：宣称续航456英里
